complicacoes.texto: Once Hourman takes a Miraclo pill, his Poderes last exactly an hour, e no more. In addition, he can’t take another pill until an hour after his Poderes fade.

Rex Tyler became severely addicted first to the rush of heroic adventure, e then to the drug that gave him his Poderes. Eventually, the Apenas way to break his addiction was to retire from being Hourman e pass the legacy on to his son Rick. Using Miraclo caused Rick Tyler to contract leukemia, e he retired from heroics. On the verge of death, he was saved Apenas by the arrival of an Hourman from the far-future, who took Rick out of time to bring him back to health e reintroduce him to his father.
